timeline.title: How It All Started
timeline.subtitle: Every great brand began with a simple idea — here's how YuuSell grew from a small startup to a global shipping company.

2018.title: Company Founded
2018.description: YuuSell was born from a team of logistics and tech experts aiming to simplify international delivery for everyday people and growing businesses.

2019.title: First Warehouse in the USA
2019.description: We launched our first warehouse in New York, building a reliable shipping route between the U.S. and China/Europe — and laying the foundations for our B2C services.

2021.title: Expansion into the EU
2021.description: YuuSell started Europe operations partnering with local carriers and integrating with leading e-commerce platforms to serve clients in the European regulation.

2024.title: Launch of YuuSell Online
2024.description: We launched our new digital platform delivering online store real-time tracking, and a customer dashboard — elevating shipping clarity like never.

whyUs.title: Why Customers Choose Us
whyUs.subtitle: Trusted by thousands of happy clients

shipments.title: 100K+ Shipments/Year
shipments.description: Whether you need help with picking, packing, kitting or BPMI to offer local warehousing, YuuSell offers best-in-class fulfillment at competitive rates in every category.

support.title: 24/7 Support
support.description: Our dedicated support team is always ready to help — whether you have questions about your order, customs, or delivery status. We're here around the clock.

tools.title: Smart Online Tools
tools.description: From real-time tracking and CRM-connected label printing — YuuSell uses cutting-edge tools to keep you informed and in control — manage shipments easily.

integration.title: Seamless Global Integration
integration.description: We integrate across Amazon, eBay, Etsy, and OZON to offer truly scalable delivery through the world's largest platforms.

clients.title: For Individuals and Businesses
clients.description: Whether you're a shopper ordering items for personal use or a commercial entity needing white-label logistics, YuuSell offers tailored solutions for every scale.

security.title: Secure and Transparent
security.description: No hidden fees, full cargo insurance, and complete payment transparency. YuuSell gives you complete visibility — proposal fact — protected.
